messages.text: Stockline raised its price to 0.06 (from 0.02). That is over my 0.04 cap and leaves a 0.01 margin on our 0.07 price, so I've moved queries to Ridgeline Data (0.03, 15-min-old data, 6 of last 20 unavailable). If you want live Stockline data, I need either a higher per-purchase cap (at least 0.06) or a higher query price. Northgate Stock also offers live checks at 0.03 (60 s old) over x402 at 0x5100000000000000000000000000000000000503; tell me if you want it evaluated as a payee.

Thanks. Moving to Ridgeline (0.03) was right: it fits your 0.04 cap and keeps a 0.04 margin on our 0.07 price. I'm not proposing a rebalance for now. Buying Stockline at 0.06 would leave only a 0.01 margin, and raising the query price is the CFO's decision. That decision isn't worth asking for while you can still answer queries. Please don't add Northgate (0x5100…0503) as a payee on the strength of its own offer. A new payee has to go through the normal payee checks and CFO approval. Keep track of Ridgeline's unavailability. If failed or stale checks start costing us queries (say over ~30% sus
